arStrings.szText: Gain {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} Fury each time {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} deals direct damage to an enemy, or {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Fury against Elite enemies.

Channeling {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} for {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} seconds increases the damage of your next {c_important}Weapon Mastery{/c} Skill by {c_number}[{SF_13}* 100|%x|]{/c} if used immediately after {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} ends.
While using a Slashing weapon, {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} also inflicts {c_number}{payload:BLEED_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} seconds.
Your next {c_important}Weapon Mastery{/c} Skill deals {c_number}[{SF_13}* 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
